fireRules: Use only established fireplaces and always check current fire-risk/fire-ban sources before publication/use.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Simlångsdalen - Mästocka, Södra delleden, S6 local/inventory label, official order 22, 26 km, hard/red, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Simlångsdalen the trail crosses Fylleån and follows the Assman valley past Danska Fall and Gårdshult before entering quieter forest, wet paths and open heathland. The section finishes at Björsjön in Mästocka, where the campsite, bathing place, toilet and seasonal drinking water sit near Mästocka ljunghed nature reserve.
importReadiness.geometry: ready with caveats: official GPX/API geo_json is canonical 550-point navigation-grade geometry; line.geometry is stale/partial and must be suppressed; Naturkartan corroborates despite old slug; OSM validation only.
importReadiness.endpoints: ready with caveats: Simlångsdalen is a shared S4/S5/S6 branch hub; Mästocka/Björsjön is an exact S6/S7 handoff.
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with caveats: Simlångsdalen direct bus access is strong; Mästocka endpoint public transit is weak/remote and should be modeled as parking/pickup/continuation access unless later live transit research improves it.
importReadiness.facilities: ready with caveats: core official facilities are sourced and coordinate-checked; access/side/noisy records need policy filtering and some OSM subfacilities should be merged.
importReadiness.water: ready with seasonality caveat: only Mästocka endpoint has confirmed official drinking water and it is seasonal 15 Apr-15 Oct; no confirmed mid-route potable water.
